name: wordapp
description: AI-powered Word of the Day web app, using Astro.js, Gemini AI, and MongoDB.
author: Visakan Kirubakaran

scripts.lint: pnpm lint:oxlint && pnpm lint:biome && pnpm lint:astro && pnpm lint:python
scripts.format: pnpm --filter frontend format && uv --directory packages run --no-sync ruff format .
scripts.format:check: pnpm --filter frontend format:check && uv --directory packages run --no-sync ruff format --check .
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm unused
